device_label: 7.5 mm TFLT MZM (800 nm SiO2 clad)
il_onchip_includes: MZM waveguide scattering (0.13 dB) plus remaining MZM loss; breakdown not itemised
electrode_metal: Au (800 nm) on Ti (15 nm); termination Pt (5 nm) on Ti (20 nm)
cladding: PECVD SiO2 800 nm, removed over the electrode contact areas; DC-drift comparison MZMs uncladded
waveguide_orientation: light along crystal y, field along z
epitaxy_or_stack: Si / 2 um SiO2 / 500 nm x-cut LT (300 nm etched, 200 nm slab) / 800 nm PECVD SiO2 / Au electrodes
modulation_format: NRZ PRBS; BER below SD-FEC at 5 GBd from 0 to 70 C; open eye at 30 GBd
driver: arbitrary waveform generator (no driver amplifier shown in the Fig. 1(e) setup)
notes: VERSION arXiv v1. Cladded device (800 nm SiO2) carries the VpiL, ER, S21 and Z0 numbers; the MZMs used for the 46 h DC-drift comparison with TFLN are uncladded. DC stability (not a column): below 1 dB power change from quadrature in the first two hours, 0.2 dB over the last 44 h, at 12.1 dBm on-chip (20 dBm off-chip) input; an equivalent uncladded TFLN MZM drifted 5 dB (Fig. 1(d)). On-chip loss 0.35 dB total is the authors' estimate (0.13 dB scattering; second-port ER of 15.9 dB attributed to 53:47 couplers and 0.7 dB electrode-misalignment loss). Two outputs: ER 38.8 dB (port with Fig. 1(c) label) and 15.9 dB. EO S21 normalised, falls about 3 dB between 1 and 3 GHz (attributed to the 39 ohm line; entered as eo_rolloff 3 dB at 3 GHz re 1 GHz, read from Fig. 1(e)) then stays near -3 dB with ripple to 50 GHz (VNA limit; dips to about -5 dB at 42-46 GHz); 3 dB bandwidth not claimed. BER below SD-FEC at 5 GBd NRZ from 0 to 70 C (5.1 dBm on-chip); open eyes at 30 GBd with 28 dBm on-chip (SNR 3.3, oscilloscope-limited). Separate 7.5 mm GSG DC and 50 ohm-terminated RF electrodes. Signal and ground widths and a Vpi voltage are not stated (Vpi not entered; VpiL 3.4 V cm over 7.5 mm implies about 4.5 V, derived by build). Propagation loss: the only figure in the paper is 9 dB/m (0.09 dB/cm, incl. bending) for an uncladded racetrack resonator (intrinsic Q 4.04e6, p.2), a different structure from this cladded MZM, so prop_loss_db_per_cm is left empty. Sidewall angle 60 deg is the Fig. 1 caption value; the reference direction (film plane or normal) is not stated.

device_label: 11 mm folded dual-output SiNx-loaded MZM (UV15-clad CPW)
il_onchip_includes: light path through the device, 17 mm total path length; breakdown not stated
il_onchip_excludes: fiber-to-chip coupling (4.44 dB per facet) and fiber-array alignment loss (2.02 dB)
electrode_metal: Au (electroplated on a sputtered seed layer)
cladding: PECVD SiO2 buffer 450 nm (thicker over the waveguide) with 100 nm PECVD SiNx strip, n = 1.943; UV15 index-matching fluid on the electrodes
waveguide_orientation: light along crystal Y, RF field along Z
epitaxy_or_stack: Si 500 um / SiO2 4.7 um / x-cut LN 300 nm / SiNx strip 100 nm x 2 um / PECVD SiO2 450 nm / Au 1 um
driver: arbitrary waveform generator via GSG probe (DC response); RF signal generator (EO response)
notes: VERSION arXiv v1. Folded layout with waveguide crossing: two 5.5 mm interaction sections (11 mm total), physical length 7.8 mm; output 2x2 MMI gives two complementary outputs. Vpi 2.98 V from a 150 kHz triangular sweep (Fig. 7(f)); abstract says less than 3.0 V; Vpi*L 3.3 V cm is the abstract value (2.98 V x 11 mm = 3.28). EO response measured as optical sidebands 3-40 GHz at 1550 nm with UV15 present (Fig. 11); text: roll-off about 0.1 dB/GHz, 3 dB bandwidth roughly 30 GHz (3 dB divided by the rounded 0.1 dB/GHz slope, entered as derived); low frequencies omitted because of unlevel RF source, so the reference frequency is not defined. Fig. 11 fitted slopes 0.108-0.137 dB/GHz. RF index: UV15-clad about 2.10, air-clad about 1.85 (p.5, Fig. 5(c); these are the values near 40 GHz, UV15 falls from about 2.4 at 1 GHz to about 2.13 at 20 GHz, air-clad from about 2.1 to 1.89 at 10 GHz); optical group index about 2.14 (simulated); electrode impedance 43-53 ohm over 5-40 GHz in Fig. 5(d), not entered (one-line curve). Text says electrode S21 at 40 GHz is roughly -3 dB (air) and -4 dB (UV15), but Fig. 5(a),(b) show S(1,2) about -5.8 dB (air) and -7.2 dB (UV15) at 40 GHz (text and figure disagree); electrode length not stated. ER 45 dB: OSA peak-to-null in Fig. 8 gives 45.5 dB (port 1) and 45.4 dB (port 2); power meter reads higher, the lower OSA value used; reverse operation about 33 dB. Fiber-to-fiber loss 12.0 dB = 2 x 4.44 dB coupling + 1.1 dB path + 2.02 dB alignment (author accounting). Ground width 75 um. Thermo-optic bias P_pi 92 mW. Fabricator not named.

device_label: 10 mm segmented-electrode dual-output SiNx-loaded MZM on Si handle
cladding: PECVD SiO2 500 nm (H_SiO2) with 100 nm PECVD SiNx strip; no UV15
epitaxy_or_stack: Si 500 um / thermal SiO2 4.7 um / x-cut LN 300 nm / PECVD SiNx 100 nm x 2 um strip / PECVD SiO2 500 nm / Au 1 um with T-segments (W_TOP 45, W_TGAP 5, W_STEM 34 um)
notes: VERSION arXiv v1. Operating wavelength not stated. Electrode: T-segments with W_SIG 50, W_GAP 6, W_TOP 45, W_TGAP 5, W_STEM 34, H_TOP 3, H_BASE 3, H_STEM 3, T_AU 1 um (Fig. 1(c)); W_STEM tuned from 10 to 42 um moves n_RF from 2.3 to 2.1; standard CPW n_RF 1.92. n_RF 2.134 at 120 GHz is the value the design was tuned to (text: chosen experimentally); optical group index 2.138 stated without method. Z_l varies +-10 ohm (about 40-55 ohm, Fig. 3(b)); no single Z0 entered. EO response 1-120 GHz sidebands at quadrature, normalised to carrier and RF power, 3 dB point roughly 95 GHz referenced to 1 GHz (Fig. 3(d)); flattening above 70 GHz. Fiber-to-fiber loss about 7.47 dB = 2 x 2.7 dB facet + 2.07 dB propagation of a 30 mm reference waveguide (0.69 dB/cm, Fig. 3(e) label 0.0688 dB/mm); this accounting uses the reference length, not the 10 mm device. UV15 cladding roughly doubles RF loss over 100 GHz versus segmented CPW (Fig. 3(a)). Design map Fig. 2(a) shows Vpi*L about 3.5-4 V cm at the chosen 6 um gap, 500 nm oxide. Vpi*L not reported (3.75 V x 10 mm derived by build). ER roughly 45 dB in abstract, >45 dB in text (Fig. 2(c)). Same stack as nelan2022 with a 500 nm SiO2 top cladding. Fabricator not named. Z_l legend colours differ between Fig. 3(a),(c) and Fig. 3(b), so the 40-55 ohm range cannot be attributed to the segmented line with certainty; no Z0 entered.

device_label: Ring-assisted MZI linearized modulator (50 GHz FSR racetrack)
il_onchip_includes: MMIs (2.2 dB) and waveguide propagation (0.3 dB)
il_onchip_excludes: fiber-to-chip coupling, 8 dB total for both facets
modulation_format: analog two-tone IMD3 test, tones 10 MHz apart; SFDR 120.04 dB Hz^(4/5) at 1 GHz and 114.54 dB Hz^(4/5) at 5 GHz
notes: VERSION arXiv v1. Racetrack with 50 GHz FSR coupled to one arm of an unbalanced MZI (50 um arm difference, MZI FSR 20 nm) through a deep over-coupled 2x2 MMI (kappa about 0.96, |kappa|^2 about 92 percent); modulation electrodes (two ground-signal pairs) along the two straight racetrack sections; electrode length, Vpi and EO bandwidth not reported. Reference racetrack intrinsic Q 1.1e6 (round-trip tau 0.988). Standalone 2x2 MMI loss 0.8 dB. Two-tone SFDR at 1 GHz: RAMZI 120.04 dB Hz^(4/5) (slope-5 IMD3, noise floor -163.8 dBm/Hz, RF analyzer limited) versus 102.31 dB Hz^(2/3) for the reference MZI (Fig. 3(b)); 114.54 dB Hz^(4/5) at 5 GHz (Fig. 3(c)); no EDFA after the modulator, PD saturation 10 dBm received (stated as 125 mW on chip, ambiguous, not entered); simulated advantage over the MZI up to 27 percent of FSR (13.5 GHz). Measurement wavelength 1594.9 nm (L-band EDFA). Etch about 250 nm leaving a 250 nm slab; waveguide and racetrack designed top width 1.2 um; 1.8 um PECVD SiO2; electrode gap 5 um; BOX, substrate thickness, electrode metal thickness and width not stated. Fabricator not named.

device_label: 1 cm dual-arm PLACE TFLN phase modulator
cladding: none drawn in the phase-shifter cross-section (air); SiON 4 um x 3 um over the LN taper in the spot-size converter
epitaxy_or_stack: Si / 4.7 um SiO2 / 500 nm x-cut TFLN ridge (210 nm etch, top 1 um, bottom 4.8 um) / Au electrodes 500 nm
notes: VERSION arXiv v1. Two GSG electrode pairs joined by a delay waveguide and crossing waveguides so the optical phase accumulates with the same sign in both pairs only when the delay equals an odd half-period of the RF: Vpi falls to about 3 V near 12, 16, 22 and 26 GHz (text; Fig. 4(a) minima read from the figure: about 3.2, 3.4, 3.6, 3.7 V near 12, 17, 22, 27 GHz) and diverges between them; the single-arm reference Vpi is 5.5 V in the text (red line about 5.2 V in Fig. 4(a)). Vpi measured from the OSA carrier-to-first-sideband ratio, wavelength 1510-1600 nm gives Vpi 2.8-3.4 V (Fig. 4(b)), wavelength of the frequency sweep not stated. Total electrode length 1 cm ('modulation length' in the abstract); per-pass length not stated. Insertion loss 2.8 dB is quoted without a definition; the setup couples fibers to spot-size converters at both ends, so it is entered as fiber-to-fiber with that caveat. EO comb: about 29 sidebands at about 2 W microwave input versus about 13 for a single-arm modulator (Fig. 4(d)). Electrode taper from 23.5 to 60 um signal width and 6.5 to 20 um gap at the probe pads. Ground width not stated; waveguide position in the gap not stated. Fabricator not named (PLACE technique only). Sidewall angle 6.3 deg is derived from the ridge top and bottom widths and etch depth and is measured from the film plane (90 deg = vertical); the paper states no angle.
